## Stage 6 — OJS Photos Upload (separate)

1. Read sheet → queue rows where **Ready To Hand over = Yes** and **Hand Over Photos Extracted** is empty/false (BCC Response Repairs, max 8/run)
2. Re-extract PDFs for photos only (`force_extract_smart_form_ids`)
3. One SharePoint folder per site (SmartForm Name)
4. Update Q2.3 / Q2.6 + set **Hand Over Photos Extracted = Yes**

Skip rows already marked Hand Over Photos Extracted.
